name: compute-contract-reference-impl-workspace
comment: Not a real npm package. Exists only to pin @noble/curves for @atiproto/* to 1.9.7 — viem/ox pin @noble/curves to exactly 1.9.1, which lacks Signature.toBytes that @atiproto/atproto-attestation's signer requires. Scoped overrides keep viem/ox on 1.9.1 while @atiproto/* gets 1.9.7.
